editorial:
Imagine being stuck two miles under the sea when a huge earthquake rips your base apart. That is exactly where you start in this ride. You follow a small group of researchers who have to walk across the dark ocean floor to find another station before they run out of air. The vibe is super tense from the start, and it feels like a race against time where everything that can go wrong actually does. You will feel the pressure building up as the team realizes they are not alone in the deep water.

What really works here is how fast the movie moves. It does not waste time with boring talk and gets straight to the scary stuff. Kristen Stewart does a great job leading the group, and the monster reveals are genuinely surprising. While some of the plot points are a bit simple, the action makes up for it. If you love monster movies, you should definitely check this out. It looks amazing in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, but if you want the best picture quality, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go.
endingExplained: As the survivors reach the final station, they discover a massive creature that looks like a giant Cthulhu. The main character, Norah, manages to get into an escape pod and blast off toward the surface. Just before she leaves, she sees a huge swarm of smaller monsters attacking. She makes it out alive, but the movie ends with a shot of the giant monster still lurking in the deep, showing that the world is in big trouble.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves creature features and high-stakes survival stories.
